ready1_open_rewrite.raw_question_text: As shown in the figure, $BD$ and $CE$ are the medians of the equilateral triangle $ABC$, and $BD$ and $CE$ intersect at point $F$. What is the measure of $\angle BFC$ in degrees?
ready1_open_rewrite.raw_answer_text:
\textbf{Solution:} Given that $\triangle ABC$ is an equilateral triangle\\
Hence, $\angle ABC=\angle ACB=60^\circ$\\
Since BD, CE are medians of the equilateral triangle ABC\\
Therefore, $\angle DBC=\frac{1}{2}\angle ABC=30^\circ$, $\angle ECB=\frac{1}{2}\angle ACB=30^\circ$\\
Additionally, $\angle BFC=180^\circ-\angle DBC-\angle ECB$\\
Therefore, $\angle BFC=180^\circ-30^\circ-30^\circ=\boxed{120^\circ}$
